title: Dr. W. S. Wrenn Dies at Home in Margaret
text:
DR. W. S. WRENN
DIES AT HOME
IN MARGARET

Funeral Services Held
At Margaret Monday
Afternoon

Dr. W. S. Wrenn, 80, died in his home in Margaret Saturday night at 10:30 o'clock after a critical illness of three months, during which time he was confined to his bed. Dr. Wrenn had been in poor health for the past several years.

Funeral Services

Funeral services were held in the Margaret Methodist Church Monday afternoon at 3:30 o'clock with Rev. E. A. Irvine, pastor of the Odell Methodist Church, officiating. He was assisted by Rev. Don Culbertson, pastor of the Margaret Methodist Church, and Rev. John H. Stout, pastor of the Margaret Baptist Church. Interment was made in the Crowell cemetery.

Two special songs, "Safe In the Arms of Jesus," and "Beautiful Isle of Somewhere," were sung by the choir. A male quartet, composed of J. P. Davidson, John Rasor, Sam Mills and T. T. Golightly, sang "Rock of Ages."

Active pall bearers were Raymond Sikes, Joe Bledsoe, W. A. Dunn, Ralph Bradford, S. B. Middlebrook Sr. and John Taylor. Flower bearers were Mrs. Raymond Sikes, Mrs. Erwin Reed, Mrs. Jim Owens, Mrs. Joe Bledsoe, Mrs. W. T. Blevins, Mrs. Clarence Ross and Mrs. John Bradford.

Honorary pall bearers were Herman Blevins, Jim Malone, Jim Owens, Ed Taylor, Luther Tamplin, Ed Dunn, Harold Kennedy, Homer Galcy, Erwin Reed, William Bradford, John Bradford, Jim Ewing, Ray Hysinger, S. B. Middlebrook Jr., Will Tamplin, J. D. Bledsoe, George Pruitt and W. T. Blevins.
